title: A small-step, 30-day AI plan
description: Build a manageable month of learning around practical tasks, feedback, and a finished project.

sections.title: Week one: build a safe foundation
sections.body: Learn the basic concepts, write a clear prompt, check a generated answer, and review privacy boundaries. Use short sessions and public or fictional material. Keep a note of mistakes and questions. Adjust the schedule to your circumstances rather than treating a daily streak as the goal.
bullets: Complete the AI basics and privacy lessons.
Try one task you can verify independently.

sections.title: Weeks two and three: practice in context
sections.body: Choose a task related to your work or interests. Break it into small steps and practice the difficult parts. Compare AI-assisted work with your usual method. Ask someone knowledgeable to review an example. Use the feedback to improve your process and decide whether the tool is helping.
bullets: Practice writing, research, or data tasks that fit your goal.
Include at least one failure case and a correction.

sections.title: Week four: finish and explain a project
sections.body: Complete a small project and document the goal, source material, method, review, and limitations. Explain it without relying on a generated script. Decide what you can now do and what still needs practice. Choose your next learning goal based on the gaps you found.
bullets: Repeat a task from week one and compare the quality.

example.title: A realistic monthly outcome
example.text: By the end of the month, you can produce a source-backed summary of a public topic, verify its key claims, and explain how you used AI. This is a concrete outcome you can assess.

exercise: Choose three short practice sessions each week. Write one specific outcome for the month and how you will demonstrate it.

faq.question: Will I master AI in 30 days?
faq.answer: No fixed schedule guarantees mastery. A month can establish useful habits and a foundation for continued learning.

faq.question: What if I miss a day?
faq.answer: Resume with the next useful practice session. Adjust the plan to your available time rather than rushing through material.

sources.name: European Commission: AI literacy questions and answers
